iterations.finding: Opening target was at screen edge and natural upward movement met a crate.
iterations.change: Move spawn toward the western lane; shorten the crate screen so the sound route remains open.

iterations.finding: The objective offered a lethal hold before actual melee reach.
iterations.change: Query the actual available attack; ask to approach until contact is possible. KO, carried and stashed targets retain finishing guidance.

iterations.finding: A whistle outside hearing range had no explicit feedback.
iterations.change: Expose a no-response message and bring the patrol route past the concealed lure position; hearing still uses the ordinary sound simulation.

iterations.finding: The nonmodal confirmation radio intercepted the first mobile escape gesture.
iterations.change: Nonmodal radio and its descendants pass pointer events through; modal dialogue keeps interaction.

verification.clockSteppedNative: Both approaches completed on keyboard and CDP touch with full health, no alert, no civilian/guard kill, no skills and the existing 4P budget. Engine time is not a human completion estimate.
verification.ordinaryBrowserReplay: UI-only native keyboard and touch; ordinary RAF, no seed, no engine reads or state manipulation. Both completed and advanced to VIP. Both were rank assassin, with 0 player detections; do not equate a successful clear with a fun new-user study.
verification.focusedFixtures: Four viewports; initial actual sight versus hypothetical exposure, deliberate/diagonal cover, KO victory gate, progress preservation, touch controls, movement through nonmodal radio.

remaining: VIP still introduces more systems than the opening. This release improves the entry, not all contract pacing.
The two opening routes share a basic rear takedown. They demonstrate choice but do not prove sustained replay value.
Developer replays cannot replace independent new-player observation or establish willingness to pay.
